title: Create an exemption for the pod label

blocks.content: You exempt `pod` on every metric so recommendations skip aggregating that label. You can add more labels in **Keep labels**. This path opens on **Configuration**.
Click **Add new exemption**. The dialog title is **Add exemption**.
Turn **All** on next to **Metric**. The metric shows **All metrics**.
In **Keep labels**, enter `pod`. You can add more labels there.
Leave **Disable recommendations for this metric and preserve existing rule state** off. Turning it on clears **Keep labels**.

The exemption is in the list on **Configuration**. You edit or delete it from that list.

On **Metrics**, open a rule and the **Exemptions** tab to see whether an exemption affects that rule. Refer to [Create exemptions](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/create-exemptions/).
